challenge_text: Take one photo of them they are not allowed to see until later tonight. Lighting has to be flattering on purpose.
Record a 15-second voice note of what you want to do to them — send it while they are in another room.
Film a slow undress from the neck down. No faces. Watch it together before anything else happens.
Set a lamp, a candle, or phone torch and shoot three stills of their body you actually like. Show them one.
Take a mirror photo together that you would never post. Keep it in a locked album.
Send a photo mid-day with one piece of clothing already gone, no caption except a time.
Blindfold them. Use three different textures on their skin. They guess. Wrong guess means you linger.
Put a toy or accessory on the bed as the only instruction. No talking for the first five minutes.
Ice cube or warm mug — pick one. Trace it until they say stay or stop.
Tie or hold their wrists with something soft. You decide the pace. They decide the word that ends it.
Headphones in. Play one song. Touch only to the beat. When it ends, you stop.
Pick a toy you have not used in a while. The other person names how it gets used tonight.
Text them one explicit instruction they have to follow in public without anyone noticing.
For the next hour they call you a name you choose. Stay in it even when you laugh.
Send three daytime texts that get filthier. The last one names a time you will make it real.
You are in charge from the first kiss until they ask to switch. No asking 'is this okay' unless they use the stop word.
Whisper what you are about to do before you do it. Do not skip the sentence.
Act like you just met. Pick them up in your own kitchen. Take them 'home'.
A full slow massage with a rule: no sex until they ask twice.
Mouth only, ten minutes, no hands. Timer on the nightstand.
Kiss every place you usually skip. Name them as you go.
Temperature play: shower hot, then cooler hands. Stay until their breathing changes.
Hold eye contact for one whole song while you touch them. If you look away, start the song over.
Use only your mouth and breath on their neck and chest until they pull you in.
Start in a room you do not usually use. Finish wherever you end up.
Against a closed door. Clothes stay mostly on until someone begs.
Parked car, driveway or quiet street. Ten minutes. Then you go inside like nothing happened.
Shower together with a rule: one of you does not get to touch themselves. The other one does the work.
Couch first. Bed is only if you both still want more after.
Go for a walk. At some point pull them somewhere slightly too public and kiss like you mean it.
Five-minute timer. Get them as close as you can. Stop on zero. Decide together whether to start it again.
Strip race. Loser gives a three-minute lap sit with no kissing.
They pick a number 1 to 10. That many slow strokes or kisses. Then you ask if they want the next ten.
One song, standing up. Grind, kiss, or both. When the song ends, freeze for a count of five.
Dare them to keep a straight face while you touch them under a blanket during a show.
Write a one-line dare on a note. Put it in their pocket. They have to do it before bed.
Take a photo of your hand on them that only they would recognize. Send it with no context.
Video the two of you kissing until it stops being polite. Watch the last ten seconds together.
Wear or hold one accessory they chose. You do not take it off until they say so.
Feather, nail, or ice. Two minutes each. They rank them. Winner gets used again.
Give them a job for the evening: they ask, you do. They only get three asks.
Tease them in a doorway every time they walk through it tonight. No follow-through until the last one.
Oil or lotion, lights low. One of you is not allowed to rush. The other one is not allowed to help.
Bite, then soothe, on a place they name. Twice.
Kitchen counter or washing machine. Something that hums is a bonus.
Outside after dark, coats on. Hands only. Back inside before anyone sees.
A 60-second dare: get them making a sound. If you fail, they get 60 seconds on you.
Swap who usually starts. The usual starter is not allowed to initiate — only answer.
Film a slow kiss from the neck down. Stop before it gets explicit. Save it for later.
Put the toy on a timer they cannot see. They find out when it starts.
Text them a role they have to stay in until they get home — even in the grocery line.
Trace their outline with one finger, never lifting, until they ask you to stop or keep going.
Take them somewhere you have never been intimate and kiss them like you might get caught.
Ninety-second dare: they pick a body part. You have that long to make it their favorite.
Send a photo of the outfit you will take off later. Nothing else — let them wait.
Lay out three toys. They pick one without looking. You commit to using it.
Write a scene on a note they find later. Play it out as written, no improvising the first round.
Warm oil, slow hands, no talking. If they speak, start the massage over.
Meet them at the door already ready. Location is the hallway until you both agree to move.
Coin flip: winner names a five-minute dare. Loser does it immediately.
